code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, INR, and alkaline phosphatase, with mild metabolic disturbances (hyperkalemia, hyperchloremia, low glucose). These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible coagulopathy, and hypoxemic respiratory failure. The pattern may be seen in severe infection (e.g., sepsis, COVID-19) or other critical illness; urgent clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
